name: Ōishida (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ōishida town emblem in white: a disc pierced by five drop-shaped notches, like a flower.
history: Municipal flag of Ōishida, a town in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 July 1961.

features.role: Ōishida town emblem — a disc pierced by five drop-shaped notches, like a flower
